excerpt: Omnirush: State-of-the-art models, free, for every profession
omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
GPT 6 Astra is the default model; GPT 6.1 Sol and the other models in your account's catalog are available from the model picker.
Choose a model and an effort level (low, high, xhigh, max) per chat.
You can also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys.
Add skills and MCP servers from the Library in Settings. Every model sees the same skills and tools.
The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
Write commands ask once per session; destructive ones always ask.
The composer's full-permissions toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call.
Download the latest build from the releases page. File names include the version, for example `omnirush-mac-arm64-3.0.1.dmg`.
Each release includes `SHA256SUMS.txt` for verifying downloads.
Your browser opens omnirush.ai/console with a device code; approve it and the app is ready.
To choose a store explicitly, start the app with `--password-store=gnome-libsecret`, `kwallet5` or `kwallet6`.
The app updates itself on macOS and Linux: use **Settings > Updates** or the **Check for Updates...** menu item.
pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev      # run the desktop app
